title: No Car Dealerships in GTA 6: Every Car You Own Starts Stolen 🚗 #Shorts
description:
You can't buy cars in GTA 6's story mode. You steal one and pay to register it: the first registration with Moses (Chapter 2) is free, after that it costs $1,400 to $100,000 per vehicle. From Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray can register your stolen car or buy it for cash (better condition = better price), and if you hit the daily sales limit you have to wait until the next day. Planes, helicopters and boats can't be registered.

Source: GTABase, "Can You Buy Cars in GTA 6? How to Acquire Vehicles" and "How to Sell Cars and Other Vehicles in GTA 6" (Nov 24, 2026).
